# Pets4Homes

> > UK's largest pet marketplace connecting buyers with verified breeders across dogs, cats, rabbits, reptiles, birds, and exotic animals.

Pets4Homes is a comprehensive pet classifieds and marketplace platform serving the UK with thousands of listings for puppies, kittens, and other pets from registered breeders. The site provides pet advice, breeder directories, and safety verification to ensure responsible pet adoption.

## Key Topics

- Pet classifieds and marketplace
- Puppies and dogs for sale
- Kittens and cats for sale
- Breeder directory and verification
- UK nationwide listings
- Pet adoption and safety
- Puppy socialization and care
- Breeder guides and tips
- Pedigree breeds (British Shorthair, Ragdoll, Bengal, Maine Coon, German Shepherd)
- Small pets (rabbits, rodents, birds, reptiles, fish, horses)
- Pet health and welfare
- Grooming and training advice

## Pet Marketplaces

- [Pets4Homes Homepage](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk): UK's largest pet marketplace for puppies, dogs, kittens, cats and other pets.
- [Puppies for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/puppies): Puppies for sale marketplace with 8381+ listings across all dog breeds.
- [Kittens for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/kittens): Kittens for sale marketplace with 2727+ listings across all cat breeds.
- [British Shorthair Kittens for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/kittens/british-shorthair): British Shorthair kittens for sale: 514+ GCCF/TICA registered listings.
- [Ragdoll Kittens for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/kittens/ragdoll): Ragdoll kittens for sale: 229+ pedigree breeder listings nationwide.

## Small Pets & Exotic Animals

- [Rabbits for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/rabbits): Rabbits for sale marketplace with 1102+ breeder listings nationwide.
- [Rodents for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/rodents): Small rodents (guinea pigs, mice, chinchillas, degus) classifieds with 836+ listings.
- [Reptiles for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/reptiles): Reptiles for sale: snakes, chameleons, bearded dragons with 993+ listings.
- [Birds for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/birds): Birds for sale including parrots, conures, lovebirds with 731+ listings.
- [Fish for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/fish): Fish for sale: aquarium and koi carp classifieds with 387+ listings.
- [Poultry for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/poultry): Poultry classifieds: chickens, geese, peafowl with 652+ nationwide listings.
- [Horses for Sale](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/sale/horses): Horses for sale: equestrian marketplace with 136+ breed listings.

## Pet Care & Advice

- [Pet Advice and Information Hub](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/pet-advice): Pet advice hub covering dog, cat, rabbit, and reptile care & training.
- [Choosing a Healthy Puppy](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/pet-advice/8-things-to-check-when-choosing-a-puppy.html): Guide to selecting healthy puppies with breeder checklist and health tips.
- [Puppy Socialization and Grooming Guide](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/pet-advice/breeder-hacks-for-making-grooming-a-breeze-for-your-litter.html): Puppy socialization guide: 5 daily steps for stress-free grooming training.

## Community & Competitions

- [P4H Puppy of 2025 Competition](https://www.pets4homes.co.uk/pet-advice/the-p4h-puppy-of-2022.html): P4H Puppy of 2025 competition: nominate your puppy and share your journey.

## Support & Help

- [Pets4Homes Support Center](https://support.pets4homes.co.uk): Pets4Homes support center: help with payments, welfare, trust & safety.
- [Submit a Support Ticket](https://support.pets4homes.co.uk/support/tickets/new): Support ticket submission form for customer issues and account management.
